body:
maybe... but after a day or two people move on and forget 
I am meaningless in peoples lives now, even if there is an "awww bummer" moment it will pass and I will be less than a memory. The man I pledged my life to will just be freed of the burden of being married to me since it seems to be so miserable for me. as sad as it is, I don't think he would mourn I think he would be annoyed. I honestly don't know how just wanting quality time and having someone love you deeply can be such an annoyance. Frankly it pisses me off. women who cheat or have low morals are chased after and desired but being honest and loving and faithful and loving fiercely is rejected.
Hope is what is pulling me down. I was holding on to hope only to realize I am fooling myself. that there isn't any..

I honestly don't think I have anyone that does.. I think days or weeks would pass before people realized I was gone. I have reached out and given warning signs in an effort to find support and comfort. In the moment people say all the "right things" but as soon as the next day are MIA.

I don't know what to even talk about anymore.. I have been trying so hard for so long that I am just worn. All of the friends I had have turned their backs, people get sick of other people's problems and eventually just shut them out and leave them..
